description: Commit 72e88ae computes golden-section progress with int(delta2 / delta1), causing every contraction update to report 100 while the search continues.
trigger: g_scale_gss performs any interval contraction with a visible ProgressBar.
expected_behavior: Intermediate contractions report progress below completion until the search terminates.
actual_behavior: Because the contracted-width ratio is between zero and one, int(delta2 / delta1) is zero and pb.update receives 100 on every iteration.

introductions.scope: The task diff introduces the progress expression into g_scale_gss.

observations.source: Commit 24 authoring finding and independent Fable mailbox source review.
observations.reach: Normal conversion supplies a visible progress string to the ProgressBar used by g_scale_gss. The faulty value affects display only, not the search objective or interval update.
observations.limits: No terminal rendering, conversion or CUDA code was executed.

limits: Standard-library scalar arithmetic modeled the source expression.
No repository or GPU execution occurred.

source.artifact: Commit-24 scale-progress source scan and scalar transcription

impact.rationale: The direct effect is premature progress completion in the display; the search computation does not use the progress value.

administrative_review_status: Commit-24 source-confirmed candidate awaiting independent ledger review.
